mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1,300,000 units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces demand-side momentum and increases the probability of a policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a supply-side contraction coupled with weak labor demand, indicating an economic slowdown that increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary policy intervention, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 102.0 and UNRATE > 3.8% in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates on equity cash flows, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with a contraction in industrial production signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 700,000 and INDPRO < 102.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, which increases inflationary pressure and reduces the probability of future rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth (proxy: GDPC1) combined with a decline in housing starts signals a broad-based economic slowdown, increasing the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0.5% and HOUST < 1300.0 in the same quarter
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.
